Principal Eigenvector Priority Derivation (Saaty's EVM)

Source: R/EigenMethod.R
SaatyEigen.Rd

Computes the priority weight vector \(W\) from a Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix (PRM) using Saaty's Eigenvalue Method (EVM) by extracting and normalizing the principal eigenvector corresponding to the maximum real eigenvalue \(\lambda_{\max}\) (Saaty, 1977, 1980). Automatically converts an upper-triangular ratings vector into a full n x n PRM if supplied.

Usage

SaatyEigen(PRM)

Arguments

PRM

A numeric square matrix of dimension n x n representing a Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix, or an upper-triangular pairwise comparison ratings vector.

Value

A numeric vector of normalized priority weights W summing to unity.

References

Saaty, T. L. (1977). A scaling method for priorities in hierarchical structures. Journal of Mathematical Psychology, 15(3), 234-281.

Saaty, T. L. (1980). The Analytic Hierarchy Process: Planning, Priority Setting, Resource Allocation. McGraw-Hill, New York.

Yuen, K. K. F. (2024). Inverse Gram Matrix Methods for Prioritization in Analytic Hierarchy Process: Explainability of Weighted Least Squares Optimization Method. arXiv preprint arXiv:2401.01190. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2401.01190

Author

Kevin Kam Fung Yuen

Examples

# Define a 3x3 Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix
A <- matrix(c(1, 2, 5,
              1/2, 1, 3,
              1/5, 1/3, 1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Compute EVM priority weight vector
w_evm <- SaatyEigen(A)
print(w_evm)
#> [1] 0.5815521 0.3089956 0.1094523
